name: House Lord Placements
note: Parashari astrology only; Jaimini/KP rules are not blended into this dataset. This file covers the generic 'lord of house X placed in house Y' technique (Bhava-Bhavesh analysis), which applies across any ascendant since it is derived from house-to-house relationships rather than from a specific planet's nature. Each entry's interpretation is systematically derived from (a) the absolute classical nature of house Y (kendra / trikona / upachaya / dusthana), and (b) the relationship of house Y counted from house X (trikona-from-X, kendra-from-X, dusthana-from-X, upachaya-from-X, or the default 2nd-from-X relation) — this is how classical Parashari teaching actually derives these combinations, not 144 independently memorized facts. To get the real, planet-specific reading for an actual chart, combine this layer with which planet rules each house for the native's ascendant, and with that planet's own planet_in_house / planet_in_sign placement, aspects, and dignity.
